crossRefs.note: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting…
Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely…
When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing…

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Jogbehah
people.line: A town in Gilead, fortified by the Gadites

people.name: Kenath
people.line: A city in Gilead, captured by Nobah and renamed

translations.web: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.
translations.bsb: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked their army, taking them by surprise.
translations.kjv: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
translations.asv: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.
